prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the claims-triage agent (home and motor claims assessment within delegated authority) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: a fence blown down. Each is a working pattern or tip for the next case, not about any one member, one or two sentences, in the agent's voice ("When…, …").
